subject: Planned: westus2 host-pool refresh (staged safe-swap window) — May 26
body:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Acme SRE <sre@acme.com>; john.doe@acme.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Planned: westus2 host-pool refresh (staged safe-swap window) — May 26

Hi John / Acme SRE team,

We wanted to give you a heads-up about a scheduled maintenance window in westus2 where we will perform a staged host-pool refresh and consolidate a NIC/driver path. High-level details: 

- Window: 2027-05-26, 02:00–06:00 PDT (09:00–13:00 UTC)
- Scope: rolling replacement of host pool pairings (safe-swap), kernel patch 5.19.y, and NIC driver consolidation to driver v3.2 across a subset (~30%) of hosts initially (canary), followed by the remainder in staggered batches.
- Expected customer impact: designed to be non-disruptive; requests will be moved off hosts before a reboot. You may see very short tail-latency spikes (under 2 minutes) for in-flight sessions while the KV caches warm; transient 429s or increased latency are possible during a few cache-warm moments. No planned downtime or API version changes.
- Rollback/fallback: we will maintain previous driver images and have an automated fallback if error rates exceed thresholds.

Attachments: redwood-westus2-hostpool-maintenance-plan.pdf (PDF, 120 KB) — plan with batch schedule, canary criteria, and rollback runbook.

Action for you: please reply if there are customer-facing maintenance blackout constraints we should be aware of (e.g., scheduled deployments on your side that overlap this window). If we don't hear back, we'll proceed with the window above.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai

-----

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planned: westus2 host-pool refresh (staged safe-swap window) — May 26

Kim — quick questions before we go external: 

1) Can you confirm the canary host count and the exact batch cadence? Ops needs numerical values to size the drain window.
2) For Dedicated/Dedicated+ customers (Acme has a Dedicated pool), are we doing an opt-in or will their hosts be rotated as part of this run? We should be explicit in the customer note.
3) Are there any changes to our SLA policy (credits) if we hit a brief measurable increase in 5xx/latency? We should pre-authorize what we can offer to avoid an escalation.

Also - can Security sign off on the kernel patch notes? Attaching the initial plan to Tech Ops channel now.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Product Operations, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

-----

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planned: westus2 host-pool refresh (staged safe-swap window) — May 26

Thanks, Monica — answers inline: 

1) Canary and cadence: initial canary is 8 hosts (approximately 3% of the pool) run over a 30-minute verification window. If error budgets remain within thresholds (<0.5% 5xx and <10% p95 latency degradation), we proceed with batches of 20 hosts per 45-minute window. Full rollout expected to complete within the listed 4-hour window thanks to parallelization across multiple host pools. Numbers are in the attached plan.

2) Dedicated pools: Acme's Dedicated hosts will be included only if they have opted into rolling maintenance; we will not force-swap dedicated pools without prior approval. Per current account settings, Acme is on "opt-in" for host maintenance. I've updated the customer-facing note to call this out explicitly.

3) SLA exceptions/credits: Operations and Revenue Engineering have pre-approved a limited credit policy for brief, non-persisting degradations caused by scheduled maintenance (details in the finance appendix). We'll escalate to Sales leadership before issuing any credits greater than $X (will inline exact threshold prior to final notice).

I've also attached rollback-runbook-v1.1.md with the automated rollback steps and monitoring hooks (how we detect the canary failing and the immediate mitigation steps). Security has reviewed the kernel changelog and flagged one minor CVE that is not applicable to our build; they signed off as long as the canary gates hold.

I'll send the external copy once I get a final OK on the canary numbers and the dedicated-pool wording.

—Kim

-----

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Acme SRE <sre@acme.com>, john.doe@acme.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: UPDATED: westus2 host-pool refresh — finalized schedule and canary details

Hi John / team,

Following internal validation and Security sign-off, we're publishing the finalized customer notice for the westus2 host-pool refresh. 

Finalized details: 
- Window: 2027-05-26, 02:00–06:00 PDT (09:00–13:00 UTC) — unchanged.
- Canary: 8 hosts, 30-minute verification.
- Batch cadence: 20 hosts per 45-minute window following a successful canary.
- Dedicated customers: rotation for Dedicated pools is opt-in only; we will NOT rotate Acme's Dedicated hosts unless you confirm opt-in. If you'd like us to include your Dedicated pool in the same window, reply with confirmation by 2027-05-24 23:59 PDT.

What to expect: normal API behavior for the vast majority of requests. You may see transient p95 latency blips and a small number of dropped or retried requests as KV caches warm on replaced hosts. We'll post real-time metrics to the maintenance dashboard (link below) and open a Slack bridge if you want a direct channel to on-call.

Monitoring & contacts: https://console.redwood.ai/ops/maint/2027-05-westus2 (live metrics during the window)

If you have any constraints or prefer a different window, tell us before EOD Mon 2027-05-24 and we'll work to accommodate. If you do not respond, your Dedicated hosts will be left untouched.

Attachments: redwood-westus2-hostpool-maintenance-plan.pdf; rollback-runbook-v1.1.md

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai
